errors.fireplace_off: Turn the fireplace on before changing the fan speed or flame level.

pair.title: Add fireplace
pair.listening: Press ON or OFF on your remote
pair.listening_hint: Hold the RC300 remote near Homey and press the ON or OFF button, so Homey can learn which fireplace it belongs to.
pair.timeout: Homey didn't hear an ON or OFF press from an RC300 remote. Move the remote closer to Homey and try again.
